text:
Avery: Candidate verbally accepted but needs a $2,500 notice buyout plus a $4,000 sign-on. L4 sign-on cap is $3,500. Can we route an exception to cover the buyout + sign-on so they can start next Monday?

Samira: Quick context: lose start = misses handoff into release sprint. Manager has asked for a one-time exception to avoid delay. Candidate's preferred start is 2025-10-06.

Devon (Recruiter): Offer signed at 09:05. Candidate says they will accept addendum if we confirm by today EOD.

Ruth (Hiring Manager): Justification: "Critical handoff; candidate unique domain experience; delaying will add 3 weeks of blocker risk." Please consider paying buyout as part of onboarding.

Avery: Two asks: 1) approve $1,000 over the L4 sign-on cap (total sign-on cash $6,500 including buyout), 2) payroll confirmation that 100% can be paid on first paycheck.

Payroll Bot: Payroll can process full amount on first run; standard withholding applies. Any combined onboarding cash >$10k triggers Comp Committee + Finance, but this is below that threshold. However, sign-on over band cap requires Comp Committee acknowledgement. Attach DocuSign and invoice for buyout.

Devon (Recruiter): Comp stub pasted:
```
Base: $130,000
Level: L4
Band sign-on cap: $3,500
Requested sign-on: $4,000
Notice buyout: $2,500
Total onboarding cash: $6,500
Start: 2025-10-06
Payment: 100% first paycheck
Justification: avoids 3-week release gap; candidate will sign addendum if approved today
```

Avery: Uploaded buyout invoice and DocuSign to ticket HR-1200 and routed to @comp-committee. Recommend marking as "one-off - notice buyout" to avoid policy drift.

Comp Committee Chair: Acknowledged. We'll expedite review; given low dollar amount and clear business impact, leaning to approve as one-off. Will post final decision within 2 hours.

Ruth (Hiring Manager): Thank you. If approved, please confirm GL routing to team 1710 (Platform).

Payroll Bot: GL string request noted. Will await Comp Committee routing before final coding.

Devon (Recruiter): Candidate ready to sign addendum via DocuSign once we confirm.

Comp Committee Chair: Approved as one-off. Finance please confirm GL 220-1710-ONB and close HR-1200. Marked as non-precedent.

Payroll Bot: Finance confirmed GL 220-1710-ONB. Payroll will process full payment on next run for the employee's first paycheck.

Avery: Closing loop  offer addendum sent and candidate confirmed start 2025-10-06. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
